answer.says: Ramesh, the dish is simple, but it is well made. The kadhi has a good thickness. Sit, you have earned your rest as much as I.
answer.thought: The heat has broken slightly, and the food is plain but satisfying. I am tired from the morning's writing, and the body demands its due before the spirit can resume its work. I will eat slowly and let the mind rest on the verandah afterwards.
